# Standard crate weights

Pack Standards Bureau, reviewed 2026-05-06.

Two crate types are in common use for soft fruit. A standard crate weighs 2.5 kg
empty and takes eight punnets; a heavy duty export crate weighs 3.4 kg empty
and is used for fruit that travels by sea.

The weights are the empty crate on its own, without punnets or liners.

web_fixture.content:
# Heavy duty export crate

Pack Standards Bureau.

The heavy duty export crate weighs 3.4 kg empty. It is heavier than the
standard crate because of the thicker board, and it is the crate sea freight
is packed in.

# Berryfield Packhouse - September consignments

Each row is one consignment of soft fruit, weighed with its crates. The crate
type column names the crate the consignment was packed in and the gross
weight includes those crates.
